title: How do I map CSV columns to a dataset in manifest.yaml?
body:
I have a CSV with `cust_id`, `cust_name`, `signup` and want it loaded into the `customers` dataset. This is my manifest so far:

```yaml
dataset: customers
source: customers.csv
mapping:
  cust_id: id
```

How do I map the other columns and set types?
author: asker

answers.body:
List every column under mapping and add a type:

dataset: customers
source: customers.csv
mapping:
  cust_id:
    to: id
    type: string
  signup:
    to: signed_up_at
    type: timestamp

Supported types:

typenotes
stringdefault
timestampISO-8601
integer64-bit
answers.author: dana
